concepts.title: Undercarriage Wear Guide – Extending Track Life in Sand
concepts.targetAudience: Equipment Operators, Workshop Superintendents, Fleet Owners
concepts.summary: Step-by-step visual guide on measuring track chain sag, sprocket wear, and pin turning to prevent premature track replacement.

hook.spokenEn: The 5-minute track inspection that saves fleet owners 8,000 KD in undercarriage wear.
hook.spokenAr: فحص بسيط لمدة 5 دقائق يحمي جنازير آلياتك من التآكل ويوفر آلاف الدنانير.
hook.visualHook: Engineer measuring track chain tension sag with a steel ruler against track shoe.

brollChecklist: Close-up of track shoe grouser bar height
Comparison of sharp worn sprocket vs new Komatsu sprocket
concepts.postProductionNotes: Infographic style with dimension arrows.
concepts.captionEn:
Undercarriage represents nearly 50% of an excavator’s lifetime maintenance cost. In Kuwait’s abrasive sand, proper track tension and timely pin turns extend chain life by thousands of hours.

Swipe through for our master technician’s undercarriage guide.
concepts.captionAr:
تمثل الجنازير والقطع السفلية نحو 50% من تكلفة صيانة الحفارة على مدار عمرها. في رمال الكويت الحارقة، الضبط الصحيح للشد وتدوير المسامير في الوقت المناسب يضاعف عمر الجنزير.

concepts.ctaText: Book a free undercarriage wear inspection by Dar Al Hay certified engineers.

slides.title: Check Track Chain Tension Sag
slides.body: Tracks that are too tight increase bushing friction by 300% in sand. Maintain 10–15mm sag per Komatsu factory specs.

slides.title: Inspect Drive Sprocket Teeth
slides.body: Worn pointed sprocket teeth accelerate link damage. Replace before teeth wear down to a sharp profile.

slides.title: Turn Pins & Bushings at 3,000h
slides.body: Turning pins 180 degrees doubles bushing life before full replacement is required.

slides.title: Clean Sand Packed in Rollers
slides.body: Packed clay and sand lock carrier rollers, creating flat spots on steel rollers.

slides.title: Free Ultrasonic Wear Measurement
slides.body: Contact Dar Al Hay for an on-site ultrasonic undercarriage wear report for your entire fleet.

hook.spokenAr: خلف كل طريق، وكل صرح، وكل مشروع في الكويت.. يقف إنسان مخلص وعائلة تنتظر.
hook.visualHook: Cinematic silhouette of a heavy machine operator wiping his brow at sunset, looking up at the sky, smiling proudly with the Kuwait skyline in background.

scenes.visual: Sunrise over Kuwait desert jobsite: Machine operator stepping into cabin, service engineer checking oil with careful focus.
scenes.talentAction: Warm sunlight catching dust; operator smiling with determination.
scenes.audioVoiceoverEn: Behind the iron and steel of heavy machinery, lies the real power: The human spirit.
scenes.audioVoiceoverAr: وراء الحديد والصلب وقوة المحركات، تكمن القوة الحقيقية: سواعدكم وعزيمتكم.
scenes.sfxMusic: Warm piano melody with gentle wind foley

scenes.visual: Montage of dedication: Certified technician smiling as an engine starts, operator expertly grading a road, team working in harmony under the Kuwait sun.
scenes.talentAction: Genuine smiles, teamwork, high-fives in safety vests.
scenes.audioVoiceoverEn: Dedicated men who brave the heat every day to build Kuwait’s tomorrow.
scenes.audioVoiceoverAr: رجال يواصلون العطاء كل يوم بكل إخلاص لبناء مستقبل كويت الغد.

scenes.visual: Operator clocking out safely at dusk, returning home to hug his child with pride and joy; Dar Al Hay & Komatsu logo lockup.
scenes.talentAction: Family embracing warmly, father smiling with deep fulfillment.
scenes.audioVoiceoverEn: We build the toughest machines so you return home safely to those you love. Dar Al Hay — Proud partners in human progress.
scenes.audioVoiceoverAr: نصنع أقوى الآليات لتعودوا بسلام وفخر لمن تحبون. دار الحي — شركاء في بناء الإنسان والوطن.

brollChecklist: Cinematic golden hour silhouette of operator putting on hardhat with pride
Genuine warm portrait of engineer smiling after completing machine overhaul
Slow-motion Kuwait flag fluttering on worksite overlooking distant city skyline
concepts.postProductionNotes: Warm cinematic film grading, emotional piano and orchestral score, deep resonant Arabic voiceover.
concepts.captionEn:
Behind every highway, harbor, and building rising across Kuwait stands the real hero: The human being operating, maintaining, and dedicating their sweat to building our nation.

At Dar Al Hay and Komatsu, we don’t just supply heavy machinery — we protect the safety, pride, and future of every worker and their family.

🇰🇼 Built with Japanese precision. Powered by Kuwaiti determination.
concepts.captionAr:
خلف كل طريق ممهد، وكل ميناء، وكل صرح يرتفع في سماء الكويت.. يقف البطل الحقيقي: الإنسان الذي يواصل العمل بإخلاص وشغف لبناء هذا الوطن.

في دار الحي وكوماتسو، لا نوفر مجرد معدات ثقيلة، بل نحرص على سلامة، وكرامة، ومستقبل كل عامل ومهندس يعود فخوراً لأسرته وأبنائه.

🇰🇼 معداتنا تُبنى بالدقة اليابانية.. ولكن عزيمتكم هي من تصنع الفارق.
concepts.ctaText: Share this tribute with the hardworking builders and engineers of Kuwait.
